headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Munsif Daily / Telangana Today / The Hindu
bullets_en: Hyderabad pub fined Rs 20,000 for wasting drinking water.
Heavy rain lashes Chennai; 22 subways reopened after waterlogging.
Two held in Haryana for allegedly attacking Srinagar-bound bus.
France’s Macron to give address in wake of violent protests.
Cockroach effigy at Delhi Ramlila event triggers queries; organisers say promoting cleanliness.
bullets_ur: Peenay ka paani zaya karne par Hyderabad ke pub par Rs 20,000 jurmana.
Chennai mein shadeed barish; paani nikalne ke baad 22 subways dobarah khol diye gaye.
Haryana mein Srinagar ja rahi bus par hamlay ke ilzam mein do giraftar
Pur-tashaddud ehtijajat ke baad France ke Macron qaum se khitab karenge.
Delhi Ramlila mein cockroach ke putlay par sawalat; intezamia boli safai ka paigham hai.
